data.name: Manus
data.gender_notes: Manus is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name Musa (Moses) in the Quran, meaning 'the one who follows Musa or Moses'. This name signifies respect, loyalty, and obedience to the Prophet and his teachings. The name Manus carries the meaning “Follower of Prophet Moses” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manus usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of prophet moses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, reminding us of the importance of following the guidance of the Prophets.
data.etymology: Manus belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Prophet Moses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manus total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

In many Arab and Muslim communities, this name is given to children as a mark of respect and homage towards this revered figure in Islamic history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Manus also carries deep spiritual significance for Muslims, representing obedience, loyalty, and adherence to the guidance of Prophet Moses and his teachings. It serves as a daily reminder for those with the name to strive towards following God's commandments and seeking wisdom and knowledge, much like the prophet himself. His obedience to God's will and to His Messenger serve as an inspiration for individuals to lead virtuous lives and remain steadfast in their faith.
